About The Golden Chick

The Golden Chick is a local chicken restaurant in Nilothi Extension, Delhi, serving fresh, juicy and delicious chicken dishes. From smoky kebabs and tandoori to crispy fried chicken, rolls and momos, our menu is built around one thing: chicken done right.

Run by owner Shantanu Sonkar. Visit us, call us, or have it delivered home.
